name: Kais Code
source:
In the year 2047, genetic engineering has blurred the line between human and animal. "Humanthropes"—hybrids of humans and animals—are created to serve society, but at what cost?

You play as Percival Morrison, a dedicated biologist who finally achieves his dream of becoming a "Humanthropologist." But when you’re assigned Kais, a highly intelligent husky hybrid with emotions as deep as any human’s, your beliefs are put to the test.

As you train Kais, you uncover the dark truth behind the laboratory’s experiments: suppression of free will, forced obedience, and a hidden agenda that could cost lives. 

Now, you must navigate trust, survival, and the haunting question: Can a creation outgrow its creator?

[From [url=https://codeburn.itch.io/kais-code]Itch.io[/url]]
